description: This file contains a comprehensive set of unit tests for the LocationService class in the OpenMRS project, focusing on CRUD operations, tagging, attribute management, and retirement functionality for Location entities.

classes.name: LocationServiceTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the correctness of the LocationService functionalities such as CRUD operations, tagging, retiring/unretiring, and attribute management for Location entities within the OpenMRS core application.

methods.name: saveLocation_shouldCreateLocationSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests that a new Location can be successfully saved and retrieved.

methods.name: saveLocation_shouldUpdateLocationSuccessfully
methods.description: Verifies that updates to an existing Location are persisted correctly.

methods.name: saveLocation_shouldCascadeSaveToChildLocationFromLocation
methods.description: Tests that saving a Location also persists its child locations.

methods.name: saveLocation_shouldRemoveChildLocationFromLocation
methods.description: Verifies removal of a child Location from its parent.

methods.name: getDefaultLocation_shouldReturnDefaultLocationForTheImplementation
methods.description: Checks that the default Location is retrieved based on global property.

methods.name: getLocation_shouldReturnNullWhenNoLocationMatchGivenLocationId
methods.description: Ensures null is returned when no Location exists for the provided ID.

methods.name: getLocation_shouldReturnNullWhenNoLocationMatchGivenLocationName
methods.description: Ensures null is returned when no Location exists for the provided name.

methods.name: getAllLocations_shouldReturnOnlyUnretiredLocationsWhenIncludeRetiresIsFalse

methods.name: getLocations_shouldReturnEmptyListWhenNoLocationMatchTheNameFragment

methods.name: getLocations_shouldGetLocationsHavingAllMatchingAttributeValues
